notes.title: Frame rate fixed for modern hardware and support for D-Pad movement
notes.content:
Frame Rate Fix

This game was originally created on a very old device and the frame rate rarely exceeded 100 fps.
On modern hardware the frame rate is well above this and rotation values are affected when more frames are drawn per second.  To resolve this issue I have locked the game to 60 fps.

D-Pad movement added

Players who prefer using a D-pad now have the option within the game as support is now added.
